name: @embedpdf/tooling-consume-fixtures
description: The release gate that tests what users actually download: packs every publishable package into real tarballs, installs them into four consumer-archetype fixtures (node-esm, node-cjs, vite-app, tsc-nodenext) in a temp dir OUTSIDE the workspace, and runs each. Sits before `changeset publish` so a broken artifact can never reach a dist-tag. Requires dist to be built first (turbo run build).
